name: employment_level
notes: Employed persons, Canada 15+, SA monthly. Scaled thousands -> millions. Numerator for per-capita employment growth (Pillar E). METHODOLOGY: headcount measure -- counts every employed person regardless of hours worked. Editorial dual-use: comparator to aggregate_hours in the hours-vs-headcount Labour plate; Y/Y of headcount vs Y/Y of hours isolates the per-worker-hours channel. When hours Y/Y slows below employment Y/Y, employers are cutting shifts before bodies (leading-softening signal). NO SIMPLIFICATION: series taken directly from source vector v2062811.
